input.summary: Add ownership clause: Company owns the Site deliverables and customer data, with licence-back of HDI IP
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement never allocates ownership of the Site, the work product HDI develops for us or the customer data generated through the Site, which by default leaves HDI holding what we are paying for. We have confirmed our ownership of the Content, Site work product, Marks and customer data, with HDI keeping its pre-existing platform and granting us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything embedded in the Site.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Marks, all customer, order and user data generated through the Site, and all designs, look and feel, materials and other work product created by or for HDI specifically for the Company under this Agreement (which HDI hereby assigns to the Company). HDI retains ownership of its pre-existing and generally applicable software, systems and tools, and grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such HDI materials to the extent incorporated in or reasonably necessary to operate the Site. Nothing in this Agreement assigns any Company intellectual property or Company data to HDI, and no work product shall be jointly owned.

input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access rights to affiliates and contractors and make them irrevocable during the term
input.comment: [Playbook] Our access rights must reach the affiliates and contractors who actually operate the Site with us and must not be revocable at HDI's discretion. We have added that scope, made the rights irrevocable for the term absent uncured material breach, and made them transferable to a successor.

ops.oldText: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
ops.newText: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information. The rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 extend to the Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on the Company's behalf, are irrevocable during the term of this Agreement except for the Company's uncured material breach, and are transferable to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of the Company's assets or business.
